places.name: Old Town (UNESCO World Heritage Site)
places.ai_summary: Dubrovnik's Old Town is a UNESCO World Heritage Site, renowned for its well-preserved medieval architecture, cobblestone streets, and historic landmarks.

opening_hours.notes: Best explored during daylight hours.

places.place_tip: Take a guided tour to learn about the history and architecture.

places.name: City Walls of Dubrovnik
places.ai_summary: The City Walls of Dubrovnik are a series of defensive stone walls surrounding the Old Town, offering stunning views of the Adriatic Sea and the city.

opening_hours.notes: Hours may vary during the winter season.

places.place_tip: Wear comfortable shoes for walking and bring water.

places.name: Stradun Street
places.ai_summary: Stradun Street is the main pedestrian thoroughfare in Dubrovnik's Old Town, lined with historic buildings, shops, and cafes. It's a vibrant hub of activity.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the evening for a lively atmosphere.

places.place_tip: Enjoy a coffee at one of the street-side cafes and people-watch.

places.name: Rector’s Palace
places.ai_summary: Rector’s Palace is a historic palace in Dubrovnik, now a museum, showcasing the city's history and culture through various exhibits and artifacts.

opening_hours.notes: Last admission one hour before closing.

places.place_tip: Check out the beautiful courtyard and the museum's collection of artifacts.

places.name: Dubrovnik Cathedral
places.ai_summary: Dubrovnik Cathedral, also known as the Cathedral of the Assumption of the Virgin Mary, is a Roman Catholic cathedral in Dubrovnik, Croatia. It is the seat of the Diocese of Dubrovnik.

opening_hours.notes: Check for mass times and special events.

places.place_tip: Don't miss the beautiful altarpiece and the treasury museum.

places.name: Lovrijenac Fortress
places.ai_summary: Lovrijenac Fortress is a historic fortress located on a cliff outside the western wall of Dubrovnik. It offers panoramic views of the Adriatic Sea and the city.

opening_hours.notes: Last admission one hour before closing.

places.place_tip: Explore the fortress and enjoy the stunning views from the top.

places.name: Mount Srđ Cable Car
places.ai_summary: The Mount Srđ Cable Car is a cable car in Dubrovnik, Croatia, that offers panoramic views of the city, the Adriatic Sea, and the surrounding islands.

opening_hours.notes: Check for seasonal variations in operating hours.

places.place_tip: Take the cable car to the top for breathtaking views, especially at sunset.

places.name: Franciscan Monastery & Pharmacy
places.ai_summary: The Franciscan Monastery in Dubrovnik is a historic monastery with a beautiful cloister and a pharmacy that is one of the oldest in Europe.

opening_hours.notes: Check for mass times and special events.

places.place_tip: Visit the pharmacy museum and explore the beautiful cloister.

places.name: Pile Gate
places.ai_summary: Pile Gate is the main entrance to Dubrovnik's Old Town, featuring a drawbridge and a large stone archway. It's a historic and impressive structure.

opening_hours.notes: Best viewed in the evening when it's illuminated.

places.place_tip: Take photos from the bridge and explore the area around the gate.

places.name: Lokrum Island
places.ai_summary: Lokrum Island is a small island near Dubrovnik, known for its natural beauty, botanical gardens, and the ruins of a Benedictine monastery.

opening_hours.notes: Ferry schedule varies, check in advance.

places.place_tip: Explore the botanical gardens and the ruins, and enjoy swimming in the clear waters.

places.name: Dominican Monastery
places.ai_summary: The Dominican Monastery in Dubrovnik is a historic monastery with a beautiful church and a museum showcasing religious art and artifacts.

opening_hours.notes: Check for mass times and special events.

places.place_tip: Visit the museum for insights into the religious art of the region.

places.name: Fort Bokar
places.ai_summary: Fort Bokar is a historic fortress in Dubrovnik, located at the western end of the city walls. It offers impressive views of the Adriatic Sea and the city.

opening_hours.notes: Last admission one hour before closing.

places.place_tip: Explore the fortress and enjoy the panoramic views from the top.

places.name: Banje Beach
places.ai_summary: Banje Beach is a popular beach in Dubrovnik, known for its clear waters, pebble beach, and stunning views of the Old Town and the city walls.

opening_hours.notes: Sunbeds and umbrellas are available for rent.

places.place_tip: Enjoy swimming, sunbathing, and the beautiful views of Dubrovnik.

places.name: Fort Revelin
places.ai_summary: Fort Revelin is a historic fortress in Dubrovnik, located at the entrance of the Old Port. It offers impressive views of the port and the city.

opening_hours.notes: Last admission one hour before closing.

places.place_tip: Explore the fortress and enjoy the panoramic views of the Old Port and the city.

places.name: Onofrio’s Fountain
places.ai_summary: Onofrio’s Fountain is a large circular fountain in Dubrovnik, located in the Old Town. It was built in the 15th century and is a popular landmark.

opening_hours.notes: Best viewed in the evening when it's illuminated.

places.place_tip: Take photos and enjoy the atmosphere of the Old Town.

places.name: Dubrovnik Synagogue
places.ai_summary: Dubrovnik Synagogue is a historic synagogue in Dubrovnik, known for its beautiful interior and as a center of Jewish culture and history in the region.

opening_hours.notes: Check for special events and holidays.

places.place_tip: Visit the museum within the synagogue for insights into the Jewish history of Dubrovnik.
